scheme_name: Exposure Visits of Government of Odisha Delegates/Representatives to Singapore and Dubai
other_conditions: Must have requisite physical fitness and not be suffering from any communicable disease at the time of travel.
Must be duly nominated by a Department of Government of Odisha.
benefits_summary: The Government of Odisha bears all costs of the exposure trips, providing delegates with airfare, accommodation, insurance, allowances, and guided tours.
